### Why this works:
**"价值被压缩到 30%" is the sharpest named-anchor compression stat in the cycle.** The "放大器" (amplifier) framing is the named-anchor Pillar 5 reframe — direct match for the persona's "a person using AI takes your job" thesis. **The Scribe should hold "30% 价值压缩" + "放大器" exactly.** Pairs with Source 5 (the 李彦宏 quote) for the "amplifier + replace 体力活" two-source arc.
